name: wharf-runs
description: Unattended runs across a fleet of Macs: dispatch a seeded branch now, later or on another Mac; the lander that finishes idle branches; pickup and move between Macs; one harness over Claude Code, Codex and Orca, and hail to reach a live session; Orca kept to the registry's scopes (orca-host). Needs the wharf module for branches and checkpoints.
